text_block_list.text:
On the way back after finishing our 
outing...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oh. Speaking of this park, remember? Come 
on, you know, that 'princess'—
choice_data_list: There was a kid like that, huh...

There was a kid like that too, wasn't 
there...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Man, that was so much fun! All in one day, 
we got romance, battles, and heartfelt 
moments!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Well, I gotta admit I was shocked at first 
when I found out he came from the future 
with a mission to save Earth from green 
monsters, though.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: ...Nga?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
What are those brats doing, huddling 
together like a bunch of sheep?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Wait... Isn't that the "Princess" in the 
middle?

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text:
This guy's always muttering weird stuff to 
himself all alone, isn't he!

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
I know, I know! Just the other day, she 
was muttering about magic and making 
squiggly doodles in the sandbox!

text_block_list.name: Girl B
text_block_list.text:
Gross. Isn't it about time you grew out of 
playing pretend?

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Young Girl
text_block_list.text:
I-It's nothing... It's none of your 
business anyway...!!

...It seems a somewhat troublesome 
situation has arisen.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, hold on... Good grief, no 
helping it.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Huh? When someone says "You can't do 
that," it's basically just code for "I 
wanna do it!", right?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Folks who get worked up over things that 
don't even matter are just straight-up 
bored out of their minds."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
There's only one damn way to blow away 
those bored-out-of-their-minds folks!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: So with that, let's do this, baby!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Heave-hooo!!

Suddenly, Gold Ship leaped into the air! 
Her whole body traced an arc, and where 
she landed was—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Daaayyyy!!

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text: Wah!? What's going on?!

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text: "Who is that!? An Umamusume...!?"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Heh, we meet again after 700 million 
years...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I've pursued you all the way here since 
the Starchian Ice Age, and now I've 
finally got you cornered!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Prepare yourself! Now is the time to 
settle this once and for all!!

...It looks like it's my turn to speak. I 
should probably play along here, but—
choice_data_list:
Keh-keh-keh! I'm gonna eat every last one 
of you!

Hmph, I need only escape to the world of 
the future once more!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Kh... Hey, brats! What are you just 
standing around for?! Hurry up and run or 
hide, dammit!!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text:
Ehh...? No, but... What are these people 
talking about...?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Daaah, stop dragging your feet! You 
guys... are you really okay with this?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Any second now, this guy's head is gonna 
split right in two... and its "real mouth" 
will slide out and swallow you guys whole, 
ya hear?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Here we go: Threeee!! Twooo!! One!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: ...!?!? R-Run awayyyy!!

Gold Ship's bizarre presence swept up the 
children, and they happily played tag 
until they were completely exhausted.

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text:
Haa, hah.... S... Some reason, today was 
actually fun...

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Phew, haha... Ahh! It's been forever since 
I ran around like a crazy person like 
that!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Dwahahaha! You satisfied now, brats?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Well, if the world's so boring, then make 
yourselves more interesting!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Was that a legendary quote just now? 
Surely that's worthy of the URA Special 
Memorial MVP Award, right?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
All right, Trainer, give me a reward! 
Permanent residency on Mars would do just 
fine~!

Gold Ship's hearty laughter echoed across 
the evening sky.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Tch, like I'd let that happen! In that 
case—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, brats, we're heading to the woods! 
Follow me! That's where his time machine 
is!!"

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text:
Huh? A forest? You just mean the woods 
nearby, right...? It's just overgrown with 
trees.

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Come on now, there's totally no such thing 
as a time machine!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Seems like you guys found a fun way 
to play in the forest—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Nah, looks like you don't know how to 
take a fun walk through the woods."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Then I'll teach ya myself! Just shut up 
and follow me!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hah... there you go, guys! Under that 
tree! The main part for the time machine 
is buried right there!

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text: Haaah? That's ridiculous. As if...

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? Wait, hold on! Something's 
actually buried here! Look...!

text_block_list.name: Girl B
text_block_list.text:
Wait, that stinks! What is this box, why 
does it smell so bad~?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oops, my bad. That's the box I buried when 
I tried growing a yakisoba pan tree.

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text:
Gyaaah!! There's something crazy with a 
crazy color in here--!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
C'mon, don't rush, we'll find it next time 
for sure. The pirate treasure said to be 
hidden in this forest...!!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text:
What we're looking for changed 
completely?!

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Young Girl
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.

Even after that, Gold Ship continued to 
enjoy exploring the woods, leading (?) the 
children along.
